'''Toufik Mansour''' is an Israeli mathematician working in [[algebraic combinatorics]]. He is a member of the [[Druze]] community and is the first Israeli Druze to become a professional mathematician.<ref>{{citation|url=http://www.israel21c.org/people/israels-first-druze-math-lecturer-does-it-by-the-numbers/|title=Israel's first Druze math lecturer does it by the numbers|publisher=Israel21c|date=October 5, 2003}}.</ref>

Mansour obtained his Ph.D. in mathematics from the [[University of Haifa]] in 2001 under Alek Vainshtein.<ref>[http://digitool.haifa.ac.il/R/?func=dbin-jump-full&object_id=525468&local_base=GEN01 Permutations With Forbidden Patterns], Ph.D. thesis, T. Mansour, 2001, from the Haifa University Theses and Dissertations Collection, retrieved 2014-09-06.</ref> As of 2007, he is a professor of mathematics at the University of Haifa.<ref>[http://math.haifa.ac.il/members.htm Faculty members] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141011210949/http://math.haifa.ac.il/members.htm |date=2014-10-11 }}, Mathematics Department, University of Haifa, retrieved 2014-09-06.</ref> 
He served as chair of the department from 2015 to 2017. He has previously been a faculty member of the Center for Combinatorics at [[Nankai University]] from 2004 to 2007, and at The John Knopfmacher Center for Applicable Analysis and Number Theory at the [[University of the Witwatersrand]].

Mansour is an expert on [[Discrete Mathematics]] and its applications. In particular, he is interested in [[permutation pattern]]s, colored permutations, [[Partition of a set|set partitions]], [[combinatorics on words]], and [[Composition (combinatorics)|compositions]]. He has published extensively in these areas.

Mansour is a founding editor of the peer-reviewed journal ''Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications'' and has served as its editor-in-chief since the journal’s establishment.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=Editorial Board
 |url=https://ecajournal.haifa.ac.il/
 |website=Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications
 |publisher=University of Haifa
 |access-date=2026-01-31
}}</ref>

Since 2022, he has chaired and organized the annual International Conference on Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications.<ref>{{cite web
 |title=International Conference on Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications
 |url=https://ecajournal.haifa.ac.il/Conference/ICECA2026.html
 |website=Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications
 |publisher=University of Haifa
 |access-date=2026-01-31
}}</ref>
